1.2_Agreement.definition: "Agreement" means this Unilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement, including all schedules, annexures, exhibits, amendments, modifications, and supplements hereto.

1.3_Applicable_Law.definition: "Applicable Law" means any statute, law, ordinance, regulation, rule, notification, circular, order, judgment, decree, directive, governmental approval, or other legal requirement having the force of law and applicable to the Parties or the subject matter of this Agreement.

1.4_Authorized_Recipient.definition: "Authorized Recipient" means any Representative who has a legitimate need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose and who is bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained herein.

1.5_Business_Day.definition: "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday on which banks are open for business in the jurisdiction specified in this Agreement.

1.6_Confidential_Information.definition: "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on, or after the Effective Date, in written, oral, visual, electronic, digital, graphic, machine-readable, or any other form, including but not limited to: (a) business plans, strategies, forecasts, and opportunities; (b) financial information, budgets, pricing, costs, revenues, and projections; (c) technical information, specifications, designs, drawings, schematics, models, formulas, inventions, know-how, discoveries, methodologies, and processes; (d) software, source code, object code, algorithms, databases, architecture, and technical documentation; (e) customer, supplier, contractor, consultant, and business partner information; (f) research and development information; (g) intellectual property and proprietary information; (h) trade secrets; (i) contractual arrangements and commercial terms; (j) data, reports, analyses, studies, compilations, summaries, notes, and derivative materials prepared from or based upon such information; and (k) any information that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential in nature. (a) patents, patent applications, inventions, invention disclosures, patent strategies, prosecution strategies, and patent portfolios; (b) copyrights, copyrighted materials, content assets, software assets, source code, object code, documentation, and creative works; (c) trademarks, service marks, brand assets, trade names, logos, brand strategies, and trademark portfolios; (d) trade secrets, know-how, proprietary methodologies, confidential processes, technical information, and business methodologies; (e) licensing structures, licensing models, exclusivity arrangements, territorial rights, field-of-use restrictions, sublicensing rights, and usage rights; (f) royalty arrangements, licensing fees, milestone payments, revenue sharing arrangements, commercial terms, and financial models; (g) software architecture, technical specifications, APIs, technical documentation, implementation materials, and technical support information; (h) commercialization strategies, product launch plans, market development plans, channel strategies, distribution arrangements, and sales strategies; (i) licensing negotiations, draft license agreements, term sheets, commercial proposals, legal analyses, and transaction documents; (j) intellectual property valuations, market analyses, competitive analyses, due diligence reports, infringement assessments, and enforcement strategies; (k) customer information, distributor information, licensee information, licensor information, partner information, and commercial relationship information relating to the Licensed Rights; and (l) any other technical, legal, commercial, financial, intellectual property-related, licensing-related, operational, strategic, or proprietary information disclosed in connection with the contemplated licensing arrangement.

1.7_Data_Protection_Laws.definition: "Data Protection Laws" means all applicable laws relating to privacy, data protection, information security, and processing of personal data.

1.8_Disclosing_Party.definition: "Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing or making available Confidential Information to the Receiving Party.

1.9_Effective_Date.definition: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is executed by the last signing Party.

1.17_Receiving_Party.definition: "Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information from the Disclosing Party.

1.2_Agreement.definition: "Agreement" means this Unilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement, including all schedules, annexures, exhibits, amendments, modifications, and supplements hereto.

1.3_Applicable_Law.definition: "Applicable Law" means any statute, law, ordinance, regulation, rule, notification, circular, order, judgment, decree, directive, governmental approval, or other legal requirement having the force of law and applicable to the Parties or the subject matter of this Agreement.

1.4_Authorized_Recipient.definition: "Authorized Recipient" means any Representative who has a legitimate need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose and who is bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained herein.

1.5_Business_Day.definition: "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday on which banks are open for business in the jurisdiction specified in this Agreement.

1.6_Confidential_Information.definition: "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on, or after the Effective Date, in written, oral, visual, electronic, digital, graphic, machine-readable, or any other form, including but not limited to: (a) business plans, strategies, forecasts, and opportunities; (b) financial information, budgets, pricing, costs, revenues, and projections; (c) technical information, specifications, designs, drawings, schematics, models, formulas, inventions, know-how, discoveries, methodologies, and processes; (d) software, source code, object code, algorithms, databases, architecture, and technical documentation; (e) customer, supplier, contractor, consultant, and business partner information; (f) research and development information; (g) intellectual property and proprietary information; (h) trade secrets; (i) contractual arrangements and commercial terms; (j) data, reports, analyses, studies, compilations, summaries, notes, and derivative materials prepared from or based upon such information; and (k) any information that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential in nature. (a) licenses, permits, approvals, authorizations, registrations, certifications, exemptions, waivers, and related regulatory documentation; (b) regulatory filings, regulatory applications, statutory returns, governmental submissions, regulatory correspondence, and approval documentation; (c) compliance reports, compliance assessments, audit findings, inspection reports, investigation reports, regulatory reviews, and monitoring reports; (d) internal compliance policies, governance frameworks, risk management frameworks, control procedures, internal guidelines, and compliance manuals; (e) legal opinions, legal analyses, legal risk assessments, litigation information, dispute information, enforcement actions, and legal compliance reviews; (f) environmental compliance information, health and safety compliance information, labor law compliance information, data protection compliance information, and sector-specific regulatory compliance information; (g) regulatory notices, show-cause notices, warning letters, compliance directives, enforcement notices, penalty notices, and corrective action plans; (h) communications with Regulatory Authorities, governmental authorities, statutory bodies, administrative agencies, and public authorities; (i) licensing strategies, approval strategies, permit acquisition strategies, regulatory engagement plans, and compliance roadmaps; (j) corporate governance information, board resolutions, committee reports, governance reviews, and governance assessments; (k) compliance training materials, compliance certifications, employee compliance records, compliance declarations, and compliance monitoring information; (l) due diligence reports, risk assessments, gap analyses, remediation plans, corrective action plans, and regulatory evaluation reports; and (m) any other legal, regulatory, compliance-related, governance-related, licensing-related, operational, financial, technical, strategic, or proprietary information disclosed in connection with the Regulatory Due Diligence.

1.7_Data_Protection_Laws.definition: "Data Protection Laws" means all applicable laws relating to privacy, data protection, information security, and processing of personal data.

1.8_Disclosing_Party.definition: "Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing or making available Confidential Information to the Receiving Party.

1.9_Effective_Date.definition: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is executed by the last signing Party.

1.10_Governmental_Authority.definition: "Governmental Authority" means any court, tribunal, arbitrator, ministry, department, commission, authority, regulator, agency, instrumentality, or other governmental or quasi-governmental body having jurisdiction.

1.11_Intellectual_Property_Rights.definition: "Intellectual Property Rights" means all patents, patent applications, copyrights, trademarks, service marks, trade names, domain names, designs, database rights, moral rights, trade secrets, know-how, and all other intellectual property rights recognized under Applicable Law.

1.12_Permitted_Disclosure.definition: "Permitted Disclosure" means any disclosure expressly permitted under this Agreement, including disclosures to Authorized Recipients, Affiliates, professional advisors, auditors, lenders, investors, or disclosures required by Applicable Law.

1.13_Person.definition: "Person" includes any individual, corporation, company, partnership, limited liability partnership, trust, association, joint venture, governmental authority, or other legal entity.

1.14_Personal_Data.definition: "Personal Data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person as defined under applicable Data Protection Laws.

1.15_Purpose.definition: "Purpose" means the evaluation, review, assessment, verification, investigation, analysis, monitoring, or conduct of regulatory, legal, licensing, compliance, governance, or statutory due diligence in connection with a proposed transaction, investment, acquisition, financing, partnership, project, commercial arrangement, or other business opportunity.

1.16_Protected_Material.definition: "Protected Material" means Confidential Information and all copies, extracts, summaries, analyses, reports, notes, compilations, derivative works, and materials derived therefrom.

1.17_Receiving_Party.definition: "Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information from the Disclosing Party.

1.18_Representatives.definition: "Representatives" means a Party's directors, officers, employees, consultants, legal counsel, auditors, accountants, financial advisors, agents, contractors, and Affiliates.

1.19_Residual_Knowledge.definition: "Residual Knowledge" means information retained in the unaided memory of an individual without intentional memorization and without reference to any written or electronic records of Confidential Information.

1.20_Security_Incident.definition: "Security Incident" means any unauthorized access, acquisition, use, disclosure, alteration, loss, destruction, compromise, or breach of Confidential Information.

1.21_Third_Party.definition: "Third Party" means any Person other than the Parties and their Authorized Recipients.

1.22_Trade_Secret.definition: "Trade Secret" means information that derives independent economic value from not being generally known or readily ascertainable and is subject to reasonable efforts to maintain its secrecy.

1.23_Written_Notice.definition: "Written Notice" means a notice delivered by hand, courier, registered post, or electronic mail in accordance with the Notice provisions of this Agreement.

1.24_Regulatory_Information.definition: "Regulatory Information" means any information relating to regulatory approvals, licenses, permits, registrations, certifications, authorizations, filings, regulatory obligations, compliance obligations, or interactions with Regulatory Authorities.

1.25_Regulatory_Authority.definition: "Regulatory Authority" means any governmental authority, ministry, department, commission, tribunal, statutory authority, regulatory body, local authority, administrative agency, or governmental instrumentality having jurisdiction over a Party or the subject matter of the Purpose.

1.26_Compliance_Information.definition: "Compliance Information" means information relating to compliance with Applicable Laws, regulations, policies, standards, guidelines, regulatory requirements, industry codes, permits, approvals, licenses, or contractual obligations.

1.27_Regulatory_Due_Diligence.definition: "Regulatory Due Diligence" means the review, assessment, investigation, verification, and evaluation of legal, regulatory, licensing, compliance, governance, and statutory matters relating to a business, project, transaction, operation, or opportunity.

1.28_Regulatory_Filing.definition: "Regulatory Filing" means any application, registration, return, report, declaration, notification, disclosure, submission, response, correspondence, or document filed with or submitted to a Regulatory Authority.

1.29_Compliance_Assessment.definition: "Compliance Assessment" means any audit, review, investigation, assessment, verification, inspection, compliance review, gap analysis, or regulatory evaluation conducted in connection with the Purpose.

1.6_Confidential_Information.definition: "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on, or after the Effective Date, in written, oral, visual, electronic, digital, graphic, machine-readable, or any other form, including but not limited to: (a) business plans, strategies, forecasts, and opportunities; (b) financial information, budgets, pricing, costs, revenues, and projections; (c) technical information, specifications, designs, drawings, schematics, models, formulas, inventions, know-how, discoveries, methodologies, and processes; (d) software, source code, object code, algorithms, databases, architecture, and technical documentation; (e) customer, supplier, contractor, consultant, and business partner information; (f) research and development information; (g) intellectual property and proprietary information; (h) trade secrets; (i) contractual arrangements and commercial terms; (j) data, reports, analyses, studies, compilations, summaries, notes, and derivative materials prepared from or based upon such information; and (k) any information that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential in nature. (a) asset performance reports, portfolio performance reports, generation reports, revenue reports, availability reports, and operational performance analyses; (b) financial models, project economics, revenue forecasts, cash flow projections, refinancing models, valuation models, and investment analyses; (c) investor reports, lender reports, board reports, management reports, portfolio reviews, and performance assessments; (d) power purchase agreements, open access arrangements, captive structures, O&M agreements, EPC agreements, land agreements, and project contracts; (e) portfolio acquisition opportunities, portfolio sale opportunities, refinancing opportunities, restructuring opportunities, and strategic investment opportunities; (f) project budgets, operational budgets, financial forecasts, business plans, asset optimization plans, and value enhancement strategies; (g) contract management information, stakeholder management information, compliance information, reporting frameworks, and governance procedures; (h) refinancing plans, debt restructuring plans, lender negotiations, financing strategies, and treasury management information; (i) asset valuations, portfolio valuations, transaction assessments, due diligence reports, market assessments, and investment committee materials; (j) operational risk assessments, financial risk assessments, insurance information, claims information, contingency plans, and mitigation strategies; (k) ESG reports, sustainability reports, carbon credit information, REC information, environmental performance information, and compliance assessments; (l) acquisition discussions, sale discussions, strategic partnership discussions, merger discussions, and investment discussions relating to renewable energy assets; and (m) any other technical, commercial, financial, operational, portfolio-related, investment-related, refinancing-related, renewable-energy-related, strategic, or proprietary information disclosed in connection with Asset Management Services.

1.25_Renewable_Energy_Asset.definition: "Renewable Energy Asset" means any solar project, wind project, hybrid project, BESS project, green hydrogen facility, transmission asset, substation, renewable infrastructure asset, or related project.

1.26_Asset_Portfolio.definition: "Asset Portfolio" means a collection of renewable energy assets owned, managed, operated, financed, or controlled by a Party.

1.29_Portfolio_Information.definition: "Portfolio Information" means information relating to portfolio performance, portfolio strategy, portfolio optimization, portfolio valuation, portfolio acquisitions, portfolio disposals, and portfolio management activities.

1.2_Agreement.definition: "Agreement" means this Unilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement, including all schedules, annexures, exhibits, amendments, modifications, and supplements hereto.

1.3_Applicable_Law.definition: "Applicable Law" means any statute, law, ordinance, regulation, rule, notification, circular, order, judgment, decree, directive, governmental approval, or other legal requirement having the force of law and applicable to the Parties or the subject matter of this Agreement.

1.4_Authorized_Recipient.definition: "Authorized Recipient" means any Representative who has a legitimate need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose and who is bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained herein.

1.5_Business_Day.definition: "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday on which banks are open for business in the jurisdiction specified in this Agreement.

1.6_Confidential_Information.definition: "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on, or after the Effective Date, in written, oral, visual, electronic, digital, graphic, machine-readable, or any other form, including but not limited to: (a) business plans, strategies, forecasts, and opportunities; (b) financial information, budgets, pricing, costs, revenues, and projections; (c) technical information, specifications, designs, drawings, schematics, models, formulas, inventions, know-how, discoveries, methodologies, and processes; (d) software, source code, object code, algorithms, databases, architecture, and technical documentation; (e) customer, supplier, contractor, consultant, and business partner information; (f) research and development information; (g) intellectual property and proprietary information; (h) trade secrets; (i) contractual arrangements and commercial terms; (j) data, reports, analyses, studies, compilations, summaries, notes, and derivative materials prepared from or based upon such information; and (k) any information that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential in nature. (a) Open Access structures, transaction structures, procurement models, power supply structures, and energy sourcing arrangements; (b) consumer load profiles, electricity consumption data, demand forecasts, usage analyses, and consumption projections; (c) generation forecasts, energy production forecasts, scheduling assumptions, dispatch plans, forecasting methodologies, and availability projections; (d) wheeling arrangements, transmission arrangements, banking arrangements, energy accounting methodologies, settlement mechanisms, and adjustment procedures; (e) transmission charges, wheeling charges, banking charges, cross-subsidy surcharge assessments, additional surcharge assessments, and related cost analyses; (f) SLDC, RLDC, STU, CTU, DISCOM, and transmission utility interactions, applications, approvals, correspondence, and compliance requirements; (g) regulatory assessments, state policy analyses, Open Access regulations, licensing requirements, governmental approvals, and regulatory correspondence; (h) tariff structures, pricing mechanisms, commercial proposals, billing methodologies, settlement arrangements, and payment structures; (i) project financial models, procurement analyses, energy cost analyses, savings projections, return-on-investment analyses, and commercial evaluations; (j) forecasting reports, deviation analyses, DSM assessments, scheduling reports, operational compliance information, and grid coordination information; (k) contractual negotiations, commercial discussions, amendment discussions, extension discussions, assignment arrangements, and transaction documentation; (l) consumer acquisition strategies, project development opportunities, strategic partnership opportunities, and market expansion initiatives; and (m) any other commercial, financial, technical, operational, regulatory, transmission-related, scheduling-related, banking-related, energy-related, renewable-energy-related, strategic, or proprietary information disclosed in connection with the Open Access Arrangement.

1.7_Data_Protection_Laws.definition: "Data Protection Laws" means all applicable laws relating to privacy, data protection, information security, and processing of personal data.

1.8_Disclosing_Party.definition: "Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing or making available Confidential Information to the Receiving Party.

1.9_Effective_Date.definition: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is executed by the last signing Party.

1.10_Governmental_Authority.definition: "Governmental Authority" means any court, tribunal, arbitrator, ministry, department, commission, authority, regulator, agency, instrumentality, or other governmental or quasi-governmental body having jurisdiction.

1.11_Intellectual_Property_Rights.definition: "Intellectual Property Rights" means all patents, patent applications, copyrights, trademarks, service marks, trade names, domain names, designs, database rights, moral rights, trade secrets, know-how, and all other intellectual property rights recognized under Applicable Law.

1.12_Permitted_Disclosure.definition: "Permitted Disclosure" means any disclosure expressly permitted under this Agreement, including disclosures to Authorized Recipients, Affiliates, professional advisors, auditors, lenders, investors, or disclosures required by Applicable Law.

1.13_Person.definition: "Person" includes any individual, corporation, company, partnership, limited liability partnership, trust, association, joint venture, governmental authority, or other legal entity.

1.14_Personal_Data.definition: "Personal Data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person as defined under applicable Data Protection Laws.

1.15_Purpose.definition: "Purpose" means the evaluation, discussion, negotiation, structuring, development, procurement, supply, purchase, financing, implementation, operation, management, or potential establishment of an Open Access arrangement, renewable energy supply arrangement, power procurement structure, or related commercial relationship involving the generation, transmission, wheeling, scheduling, banking, and consumption of electricity under applicable Open Access regulations.

1.16_Protected_Material.definition: "Protected Material" means Confidential Information and all copies, extracts, summaries, analyses, reports, notes, compilations, derivative works, and materials derived therefrom.

1.17_Receiving_Party.definition: "Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information from the Disclosing Party.

1.18_Representatives.definition: "Representatives" means a Party's directors, officers, employees, consultants, legal counsel, auditors, accountants, financial advisors, agents, contractors, and Affiliates.

1.19_Residual_Knowledge.definition: "Residual Knowledge" means information retained in the unaided memory of an individual without intentional memorization and without reference to any written or electronic records of Confidential Information.

1.20_Security_Incident.definition: "Security Incident" means any unauthorized access, acquisition, use, disclosure, alteration, loss, destruction, compromise, or breach of Confidential Information.

1.21_Third_Party.definition: "Third Party" means any Person other than the Parties and their Authorized Recipients.

1.22_Trade_Secret.definition: "Trade Secret" means information that derives independent economic value from not being generally known or readily ascertainable and is subject to reasonable efforts to maintain its secrecy.

1.23_Written_Notice.definition: "Written Notice" means a notice delivered by hand, courier, registered post, or electronic mail in accordance with the Notice provisions of this Agreement.

1.24_Open_Access.definition: "Open Access" means the non-discriminatory use of transmission systems, distribution systems, electricity networks, or associated infrastructure by eligible consumers, generators, traders, suppliers, or other participants for the transmission and supply of electricity under Applicable Law.

1.25_Open_Access_Consumer.definition: "Open Access Consumer" means any consumer eligible under Applicable Law to procure electricity through an Open Access arrangement.

1.26_Wheeling_Arrangement.definition: "Wheeling Arrangement" means any arrangement relating to the conveyance, transportation, delivery, transfer, or movement of electricity through transmission or distribution networks.

1.27_Banking_Arrangement.definition: "Banking Arrangement" means any arrangement under which surplus electricity injected into the grid may be credited, stored notionally, adjusted, carried forward, or utilized subsequently in accordance with Applicable Law.

1.28_Scheduling_Information.definition: "Scheduling Information" means information relating to generation schedules, consumption schedules, dispatch schedules, forecasting requirements, deviation management obligations, and load management activities.

1.29_Open_Access_Documentation.definition: "Open Access Documentation" means applications, approvals, permits, agreements, wheeling agreements, banking agreements, transmission agreements, scheduling documentation, regulatory filings, and related contractual documentation.

(a) group captive ownership structures, shareholding structures, participation structures, governance arrangements, and compliance frameworks; (b) shareholder participation information, membership information, equity allocations, voting rights, governance rights, and ownership obligations; (c) electricity consumption data, participant consumption information, load profiles, consumption forecasts, demand forecasts, and energy allocation methodologies; (d) generation forecasts, energy production forecasts, scheduling assumptions, dispatch plans, availability projections, and energy accounting methodologies; (e) group captive compliance analyses, ownership compliance assessments, consumption compliance assessments, legal reviews, and regulatory evaluations; (f) shareholder agreements, participation agreements, subscription arrangements, governance documents, investment arrangements, and transaction structures; (k) operational reports, scheduling reports, forecasting reports, compliance reports, participant reports, and performance reports; (l) strategic expansion plans, participant onboarding opportunities, project development opportunities, and strategic partnership opportunities; and (m) any other commercial, financial, technical, operational, regulatory, ownership-related, participation-related, consumption-related, energy-related, group-captive-related, renewable-energy-related, strategic, or proprietary information disclosed in connection with the Group Captive Arrangement.

clauses.16.2: Neither Party shall use the name, logo, trademark, trade name, service mark, brand, or other identifying information of the other Party in any public communication, promotional material, advertisement, publication, or marketing activity without the prior written consent of the other Party.
clauses.16.3: Notwithstanding anything contained herein, either Party may make a disclosure to the extent required by: (a) Applicable Law; (b) any stock exchange or securities regulatory requirement; (c) any Governmental Authority; (d) any court, tribunal, or arbitral authority having jurisdiction; or (e) any regulatory, compliance, or reporting obligation applicable to such Party, Provided that, to the extent legally permissible, the disclosing Party shall promptly notify the other Party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment or protective measures with respect to such disclosure.
clauses.16.4: Any disclosure made pursuant to Clause 16.3 shall be limited to the minimum information legally required to be disclosed.
clauses.16.5: The obligations contained in this Clause shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement for a period of two (2) years thereafter.
